description: This file defines the 'CopierGenerator' class responsible for generating deep and shallow copier classes for serializable types within the Orleans code generation framework. It includes methods for generating copier classes, handling member copying, managing dependencies on external copiers, and supporting special cases like exception types and immutable types.

classes.name: CopierGenerator
classes.description: Class responsible for generating copier classes for serializable types, including methods for creating deep and shallow copy classes, managing member copying, and handling type-specific copier logic.

classes.name: CopierGenerator.BaseCopierFieldDescription
classes.description: Represents a description of the base type copier field within the copier generator.

classes.name: CopierGenerator.CopierFieldDescription
classes.description: Represents a description of a specific copier field, including its type and underlying type symbol.

methods.name: GenerateCopier
methods.description: Generates a copier class declaration for a serializable type, including constructors, member copying methods, and base class inheritance.

methods.name: GenerateMemberwiseDeepCopyMethod
methods.description: Creates a method that performs a member-wise deep copy of an object, utilizing field copiers and handling various type cases.

methods.name: GenerateBaseCopierDeepCopyMethod
methods.description: Creates a method to deep copy the base type part of an object, if applicable.

methods.name: GetFieldDeclarations
methods.description: Builds field declarations for the generated copier class based on field descriptions.

methods.name: GetFieldDescriptions
methods.description: Collects descriptions of fields used by the copier, including base type, activator, copier fields, and serialization hooks.

methods.name: GetCopierFieldDescriptions
methods.description: Populates a list with descriptions of copier fields required for members.

methods.name: GenerateMemberCopy
methods.description: Generates expressions for copying individual members, potentially using injected copiers or static copy methods.

methods.name: AddSerializationCallbacks
methods.description: Injects hooks for serialization-related callbacks into the copying process based on serialization hooks.

methods.name: GetCreateValueExpression
methods.description: Determines how to instantiate a new object during copying, either via activator or object creation expression.
